plan.title: Add GPT-6.1 Terra (gpt-6.1-terra): catalog, cost, Codex floor, CLIProxy route
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: One new model id propagated across every model surface (capabilities, providers, fallback, cost, Codex floor, Codex context pin test, CLIProxy exclusion note, server API map, Settings catalog, two pickers, display name, docs, changelog). This is the same file set as #4423 (GPT-6.1 Sol) minus codex.ts; each item is a one-to-few-line edit, and splitting into sibling issues would ship a model that is selectable but unpriced or unfloored.

narratives.Problem: OpenAI released gpt-6.1-terra on 2026-10-26, the GPT-6.1 workhorse tier below gpt-6.1-sol. Overdeck does not know the id: it is absent from the model catalog, pickers, cost tables and Codex floor table, so it cannot be picked, is unpriced, and a launch under ChatGPT sign-in on Codex below 0.159.0 would fail with HTTP 400 instead of being refused up front.
narratives.Proposal: Repeat the PAN-4422 (gpt-6.1-sol) change for gpt-6.1-terra with the issue's decisions: workhorse class, efforts low..max, 272K pin, $1/$0.05/$5 pricing ($3/1M blended), Sonnet 5.5 fallback, ordering right after gpt-6.1-sol. Both implementation checkpoints were resolved during planning: the Codex floor was measured at 0.159.0 (0.158.0 answers 400 model_not_found), and CLIProxy 7.3.16 does not serve the model, so per the D8 fallback Terra stays out of GPT_56_MODELS, gets a negative-probe note, and the pin bump is follow-up PAN-4634. See .pan/drafts/PAN-4633.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Releasing to npm (post-merge pan release stable --version 0.72.0 from main)
- Changing any default, tierModels, preset or role model
- Adding gpt-6.1-terra to GPT_56_MODELS or bumping the CLIProxy version (PAN-4634)
- Adding a harness-policy gate that refuses claude-code + gpt-6.1-terra
- Changing any gpt-6.1-sol, gpt-6-sol or gpt-5.6-terra row, including the stale GPT-6.1 Sol '272,000 default' wording in MODEL-CONTEXT-AUDIT.md
- Editing src/lib/runtimes/codex.ts, src/lib/model-capabilities.ts or SUBSCRIPTION_ONLY_OPENAI_MODELS
- Rebuilding sync-sources/hooks/record-cost-event.js
- Editing evals/ or tests/unit/evals/
- Adding a [372k] or other context variant, or surfacing the none or ultra effort levels

autoDecisions.summary: D7 Codex floor is 0.159.0, measured rather than assumed
autoDecisions.rationale: During planning, codex exec -m gpt-6.1-terra under ChatGPT auth returned 400 model_not_found on 0.158.0 and a completion on 0.159.0; npm has no stable release in between.

autoDecisions.summary: D8 takes its fallback: gpt-6.1-terra is not added to GPT_56_MODELS; follow-up PAN-4634 filed
autoDecisions.rationale: CLIProxy 7.3.16 omits the id from GET /v1/models and answers 'unknown provider for model gpt-6.1-terra' to POST /v1/messages; the issue's D8 rule prescribes this fallback. getClaudeCodeContextPolicyForModel still returns 272K through the capability fallthrough, so no observable policy changes.

autoDecisions.summary: No harness gate for claude-code + gpt-6.1-terra
autoDecisions.rationale: D8's fallback names only the membership and the follow-up issue; a new gate is new behavior outside the issue's scope. The limitation is documented in harnesses.mdx and the changelog.

autoDecisions.summary: Settings modelCatalog row uses icon Sparkles and tier 'balanced'
autoDecisions.rationale: Terra is the balanced/workhorse tier; the existing gpt-5.6-terra row uses that style, while Sol rows use Gem/premium.
No measured Terra skill data exists; PAN-4422 copied the same-slot predecessor (gpt-6-sol) for gpt-6.1-sol.

autoDecisions.summary: Changelog creates a v0.72.0 Unreleased block
autoDecisions.rationale: No Unreleased block exists on main and v0.71.0 is the current release, as the issue's D11 directs.
